s.n: Ivana's chessboard blini with smoked salmon
s.note: Buckwheat blini, salmon, sour cream, dill. How Ivana keeps warm in Russia.
s.how: Whisk the flours, baking powder and a pinch of salt with the egg, milk and half the butter into a thick batter. Brush a frying pan with butter and drop in tablespoons of batter; cook until bubbles show, flip and cook another minute. Season the sour cream with lemon zest and a squeeze of juice. Top half the blini with salmon and half with just sour cream and dill, and set them out in a chequerboard.

s.note: Prawns, iceberg and Marie Rose in tiny glasses. Mini-sized, one-eighth the size.
s.how: Mix the mayonnaise, tomato sauce, Tabasco and a squeeze of lemon into a Marie Rose sauce. Spoon lettuce and a little avocado into 8 small glasses. Pile on the prawns, hang one over each rim and spoon over the sauce. Dust with paprika and serve with lemon wedges.

s.note: Would you like some chicken? I've got more. Buttermilk drumsticks, hot honey, pickles.
s.how: Soak the drumsticks in the buttermilk with a big pinch of salt for at least 30 minutes, or overnight. Mix the flour, paprika, garlic powder and salt, then roll the drumsticks in it, pressing to coat. Fry in oil at 160C, in batches, turning, until deep gold and cooked through. Warm the honey with the chilli, drizzle over and serve with pickles.

m.n: Get in my belly sticky baby back ribs
m.note: Slow-baked pork ribs, smoky glaze, slaw. Get in my belly.
m.how: Rub the racks all over with the sugar, paprika, garlic powder and 2 tsp salt. Wrap each rack tightly in foil and bake at 150C until the meat pulls back from the bones. Simmer the barbecue sauce, half the vinegar and the honey until glossy. Unwrap, brush with glaze and grill under high heat, brushing twice more, until sticky and charred. Toss the cabbage and carrot with the mayo and remaining vinegar, and serve with the ribs.
shop: 2kg pork baby back ribs, in racks@Meat

m.n: The Alan Parsons Project steak Diane
m.note: Sirloin flamed with brandy, creamy pan sauce. Flambéed like a laser on the moon.
m.how: Bake the chips in a hot oven until crisp. Season the steaks and sear in the oil over high heat, 3 minutes a side for medium rare, then rest. Melt the butter and soften the shallots and garlic. Pour in the brandy, carefully set it alight and let the flames die down. Stir in the mustard, Worcestershire, cream and resting juices and bubble until glossy. Spoon the sauce over the steaks, scatter with parsley and serve with the chips.

w.n: Belgian Dip waffles with coffee cream
w.note: Liege waffles to dunk in sweet coffee cream. The Belgian Dip, milk mustache and all.
w.how: Mix the flour, yeast, milk and eggs into a dough, then knead in the butter until smooth. Cover and leave in a warm spot until puffy. Knead in the pearl sugar and cut into 8 balls. Cook in a hot waffle iron until deep gold and caramelised. Whip the cream with the icing sugar and coffee dissolved in a little hot water, and serve for dunking.
shop: 100g pearl sugar or crushed sugar cubes@Pantry

d.note: White rum, lime, mint and soda, in a tall glass. Austin's mojo, stolen back.
d.how: Muddle the mint, sugar and juice of a lime gently in each of 4 tall glasses. Add the rum and fill with crushed ice. Top with soda, stir up from the bottom and garnish with mint.
